shadows.name: button-edge
shadows.purpose: Small structural button edge; absent from tabs, sidebar and text buttons.

motion.name: view-reveal
motion.purpose: Opacity .8 to 1; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

provenance.cascade: style.css loads before workspace.css; dark workspace overrides are authoritative
provenance.verification: Tokens checked against source cascade. Parent task reports final rendered reviewer disposition: ship; named currency and rate fixes resolved, including percentage inputs and source-currency editable tables.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Compact green calculation or confirmation action.

components.name: Financial field
components.description: Explicit percentage label with a numeric entry field.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Discount rate (%)<input class="ds-field" type="number" value="14.5" step="0.1"></label>

components.name: Statement selector
components.html: <nav class="ds-statements" aria-label="Statement"><button aria-pressed="true">Income statement</button><button aria-pressed="false">Balance sheet</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-statements{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}.ds-statements button{font:600 14px/1.55 var(--sans,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif);padding:7px 13px;min-height:36px;background:var(--soft,#21262d);color:var(--ink,#e6edf3);border:1px solid var(--line,#30363d);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #010409;cursor:pointer}.ds-statements button:hover{background:#30363d;border-color:#8b949e}.ds-statements button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#263749;border-color:#58a6ff}.ds-statements button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#58a6ff);outline-offset:4px}.ds-statements button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

narrative.overview: A compact, approachable dark workspace for teenage finance learners, students and analysts. Preserve original Valuation Lab branding, plain financial language and inspectable assumptions. This is the implemented code-led direction, replacing the rejected light editorial system.
keyCharacteristics: Blue focus, green actions, green/red candlesticks

rules.name: Source authority
rules.body: workspace.css overrides style.css; legacy paper, white and serif variable names do not imply light surfaces or serif typography.

rules.name: Tonal structure
rules.body: Use borders and dark surface steps; only ordinary buttons receive the small edge shadow.

dos: Do retain original Valuation Lab branding.
Do keep currency, unit and rate labels visible.
Do preserve keyboard focus and responsive table scrolling.
Do review the working interface directly.
donts: Don't restore the light editorial palette or serif headings.
Don't use code editors for normal calculations.
Don't imply display conversion changes source inputs or calculator denominations.
